caption: The drawing consists of two large vertical rectangular sections positioned side by side, separated by a narrow vertical strip of empty, light-colored space. Each rectangle is filled with a dense arrangement of parallel lines running vertically, with minor variations in their angles and thickness. The lines are composed of multiple colors, including shades of green, blue, brown, and a muted red, giving the overall drawing an earth-toned appearance. The background within each rectangle appears to be a lighter beige or off-white color, with the colored lines closely spaced and covering almost the entire area of each section. The narrow strip of background between the two filled rectangles matches the lighter background within the rectangles. There are no distinct objects or recognizable figures, only the repeated, colored vertical lines.
title: Rug Runner
